"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden and Vice President Harris condemned the gruesome violence, including conflict-related sexual violence, demonstrated by Hamas.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States wants to see Hamas defeated.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden traveled to Israel, as the first U.S. president to do so at a time of war, in the days after October 7 to demonstrate that the United States stands with Israel in its quest for peace and security.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden defended Israel at the U.N. against one-sided efforts to condemn Israel.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration worked with Congressional leaders to pass a historic aid package worth $14 billion to help Israel defend itself.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Administration worked with Congressional leaders to provide more than $1 billion for additional humanitarian aid to Gaza.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is determined to broker an immediate and lasting ceasefire deal that, once finalized, secures the return of all hostages, including the remaining Americans held in Gaza.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is determined to broker a ceasefire deal that, once finalized, addresses the immense civilian pain and extreme suffering being caused by the conflict, including the displacement and death of so many innocent people in Gaza.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is determined to broker a ceasefire deal that, once finalized, results in a durable end to the war in Gaza.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden is determined to broker a ceasefire deal that, once finalized, sets the stage for a lasting regional peace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden made clear to the world the importance of this ceasefire.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden and his team are working at the highest levels to finalize this ceasefire deal.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
